messages:
jordan: Morning — handing off oncall to @maya. Quick FYI: we have a planned deploy scheduled for 2026-03-17 11:30 UTC (11:15-11:45 freeze window). It's a schema-only migration (add nullable column + background backfill). Expected risk: low, but DB-side backfill can spike locks for a short period. I will be online for the first 30m after the deploy.

maya: Got it, taking primary. Thanks for the heads up. Can you drop the migration plan + smoke checklist? I'll coordinate watchers.

jordan: Pasted below and added links. Migration plan (short):
```
1) Run migration: ALTER TABLE features ADD COLUMN new_flag BOOLEAN DEFAULT NULL;
2) Start backfill job: /run-backfill --batch=1000 --throttle=200ms
3) Monitor locks and latency for 20m
```
Smoke checklist:
- smoke endpoint: POST /api/v1/feature-check payload {"user_id": 123}
- run basic embed+generate samples in prod-preview
Links: https://confluence.redwood/migrations/2026-03-feature-flag https://playbook/redwood/smoke-tests

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: feature-flag-add-column by @jordan at 2026-03-17T11:30:00Z. Canary groups: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Auto-rollback on error-rate > 2% or latency > 800ms for 3 consecutive mins.

sam: I can cover canary and run smoke tests during rollout. I'll watch the canary dashboards and run the POST checks after each step.

alec: FYI I'll keep an eye on DB locks/replication lag. If I see any sustained lock wait > 500ms or replica lag > 2s I'll call for pause. Also can run a quick explain on the backfill query.

kevin: Quick q: what are our page thresholds for this deploy? Who gets paged first?

jordan: Thresholds for this change:
- page SRE on p99 latency > 600ms for 5m or error rate > 1% for 3m
- auto-rollback triggers are as deploy-bot mentioned (2% / 800ms for 3m)
- If DB lock wait > 500ms or replication lag > 2s, @alec gets paged, then SRE on escalation.

maya: Watchers: I'm primary watcher for overall service (app + routing), @sam is canary/smoke, @alec is db-resp. Jordan will be backup for 30m post-deploy. Oncall rota note: I'll escalate to @kevin if we need rollback.

jordan: Handoff notes (brief):
- preflight: run the linked smoke suite + confirm canary dashboard green
- during: watch canary -> expand -> observe errors/latency + DB metrics
- rollback: `deploy rollback feature-flag-add-column --to previous` and kill backfill job if running
- post: confirm backfill completion in logs and close the deploy ticket

maya: Understood. I'll post a short status every 10m while canarying. If anything looks off I'll ping in #incidents and page per thresholds. :thumbsup:

sam: Will report smoke pass/fail per step. If smoke fails I'll stop the rollout and collect traces.

jeff (not in thread): FYI I'll be out but left runbook on the link, ping me if you need the backfill script param.

mike (not a watcher): Thanks for the handoff team.

jordan: Thanks — leaving rerun commands below in case someone needs them quickly:
`psql -c "SELECT count(*) FROM features WHERE new_flag IS NULL;"`
`/run-backfill --batch=1000 --dry-run`

maya: Okay taking over. See you all on the post-deploy check-in in ~45m. :v:
